summary: Argenx SE filed a Form 6-K reporting its Annual General Meeting results and the appointment of Karen Massey as CEO, effective immediately, succeeding founder Tim Van Hauwermeiren, who becomes Chairperson. The transition is the core event, not a routine meeting report. No deal terms or premium involved. The board appointed Massey after shareholder approval, with 90.9% of capital represented. This is an abrupt leadership shift marking a strategic evolution. Watch for execution risk under new management and potential strategic direction changes.
